description: Source code for a video decoder class using libvpx for VP9 decoding, including initialization, decoding, error handling, and decode-to-texture support.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding VP9 video streams using libvpx, supporting initialization, input buffer processing, error reporting, and optional decode-to-texture output.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video decoder with codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: ~VideoDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that resets the decoder state.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callback functions.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to flush remaining frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and releases resources.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Destroys the libvpx decoder and releases resources.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer and produces a video frame.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decoded frame as a decode target in decode-to-texture mode.
